scripts.build: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run build -w @otter/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w @otter/server" "npm run dev -w @otter/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @otter/shared && npm run test -w @otter/server && npm run test -w @otter/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @otter/shared && npm run typecheck -w @otter/server && npm run typecheck -w @otter/web
